description_en: The API for searching media asset segments by face image (fine search) returns information about relevant character segments in the media asset where the face appears, based on coarse search results
description_zh: 人脸图片搜媒资片段接口（精搜），基于粗搜结果返回该人脸所在媒资的相关人物片段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media-clip-by-face --search-lib-name test1 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --entity-id 2d3bf1e35a1e42b5ab338d701efa0000 --face-search-token zxtest-huangxuan-2023-3-7-V1 --media-id 3b187b3620c8490886cfc2a9578c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMediaClipByFace

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The value of this parameter is the same as that of the FaceSearchToken parameter in the SearchMediaByFace request. This specifies to return media asset clips that meet the same query conditions
parameters.help_zh: 与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612893.html里的FaceSearchToken的值保持一致，通过该参数判断是同一个搜索条件下的分页返回
parameters.name: face_search_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id
